about: The rep ceiling on a sparse rack (K-534, ADR-045 #73). When the gym has no next load for a move (NO_HEAVIER), or the next one is too far and the sets are not yet worth taking it (TOO_FAR, ADR-041 #55), the target is one more rep than the weakest set — past the top of the range, but never past the range's max + ceilingAbove (rep_ceiling_above_range). At that ceiling the target stops, and the phone says the rack has no next load to reach. The backend (RepCeilingTests) and the app (rep-ceiling.test.ts) read these same cases. oneMore: the target reps; atCeiling: whether a target of these reps is the ceiling, the note's condition.
